name: 摇曳天堂：命运之钟（Swaying Heaven：Destiny Clock）
detailed_description:
“The clock of fate has already been hung high, waiting for the one prophesied by Eros.”

 

Brief introduction of story

As the proxy of the God Arl in Vissantia, the term "Child of God" is originally a symbol of the deity's favor.

However, when this identity falls upon you, an orphan, it seems more like a mischievous mockery of fate.

Every choice you make will toll the bell of destiny.

Walking on thin ice, how will you manage to survive amidst the "Death God Nevah"?

Seek out the truth beneath the surface.  At the moment when you figure out the truth, how will you choose to move forward?

Perhaps the destiny in your hands will provide the answer.

Character introduction

  • Ria

“Assigned to serve in District 11, police badge number 9181, Black-level Escort Police.”

——All the answers turn into circles, and in the only overlapping area, you stand there.

The Black-level Escort Police assigned by the Human Federation to protect you seems to have little interest in protecting you, but she appears to be the only human among this group of people?

There is a cold fragrance of sandalwood and jasmine, and the blue eyes are like a calm lake, so cold and detached that she doesn't seem like a human.

A robot? A Public Realm police officer? What on earth is the conspiracy of the man whom she calls "father"?

The truth is gradually emerging. The fate named "War Machine" is a new shackle after escaping from the pain.

 

  • Siren

"Where are you going to run to, my dear?"

——She is a person who is loyal to her desires. What's more, she is really cute, which makes her the most irresistible type.

She is one of the top teenage divas in all of Vissantia. When you were strapped for cash in the church, you still bought many of her albums.

The sweet fragrance of red wine and roses. Her long life has brought countless torments.

A vampire? A mermaid? What terrifying secrets are hidden in her past, considering her unpredictable mood swings between joy and sorrow?

As the truth gradually emerges, the curse engraved in her blood is a mischievous "gift" from fate.

 

  • Fenrir

"Just a stupid sheep. Why meddle so much? Do you want to die?"

——The gods took the rib beside my heart and fashioned it into your form.

On the land of Lyngvi, pride exists alongside the young wolf king.

With the fragrance of citrus and amber, her usual behavior can be quite unrestrained, but surprisingly, as an orc, she also has her fastidious moments.

An orc? A giant wolf? Is it you or her who is trapped by the gladiatorial arena and a humble background?

As the truth gradually comes to light, under the pursuit of the son of Odin, can you two escape from the labyrinth of fate that hunts wolves?

 

  • Berial

"The long-unseen pungent smell of the deity. Welcome, the newly ascended god of District 11."

——The obsession named "Messiah" is the only singularity among all the impossibilities.

The Great Demon Lord who commands the Seventy-two Pillars of Demon Gods and the mistress of the Pandemonium. Her past seemingly has a connection with the God Arl.

With the fragrance of burning incense and cedar, she, who is resolute in killing and making decisions, is well aware of the darkest and cruelest aspects of the world.

A demon? An angel? If you were in that situation, would you save the common people or save yourself?

As the truth gradually emerges, under the oppressive power of authority, fate, in its impudent manner, announces the return of the nightmare.

 

  • Barke & Kelsey

The two members of the gang that bullied you in the General Church of Vissantia. They have resorted to every means to persecute you.

 

  • K

A lackey of Ria. It is a product of some unknown technology, in the shape of a small flying object, and it is related to Ria's past.

 

Gameplay

A romance text-based game with a massive amount of text and multiple endings.

The endings are categorized into Dead (Death Ending), Madness (Insanity Ending), Hell (Hellish Ending), Bad (Bad Ending), Happy (Happy Ending), Best (Best Ending), and True (True Ending).

Please follow the voice of your heart and toll the bell of your own destiny. You will reap an ending that is uniquely yours.

Ria, Siren, Fenrir, and Belial are four characters that can be courted. They each have their exclusive endings and side stories. Making the wrong choice between two options in the early stage will lead to a Death Ending, so please choose carefully.

The main character has freedom in gender identity. All the characters that can be courted are powerful women. In the early stage, all characters are villains. Please play with caution. If you have any concerns, please avoid playing this game on your own initiative.  

 

Art

With an original 2.9D art style, it pursues a sense of anthropomorphic realism to create an authentic romantic experience.

The logo, UI, etc. are all original, designed around the theme of "Swaying Heaven: Destiny Clock".

 

Voice Acting

Due to budget issues of the project, there is currently no voice acting. If the budget is sufficient, voice acting will be added in the follow-up.

 

Production Team Members

The studio is a one-person team.

Producer/Screenwriter/Performer/Scene Designer/Character Designer/CG Artist/Programmer/Supervisor/UI Designer/PV Designer/Art Promotion Designer/Tester: AIRhythm herself.

Theme Song/Character Solo Song: Bobby - Aspiring to be the Producer of Red Velvet.
